'''Splitter''' heals itself by 800 health and changes its name to '''Lower Body''', while also summoning the [[Split]]. }} ==Description== The '''Splitter''', internally referred to as '''Hex Corpse''', is an enemy that appears in [[Polluted Wasteland II]]. It has a high amount of health and quite fast speed. Upon death, it will split in half, changing itself into the '''Lower Body''', while also summoning the [[Split]], which is referred to as ''Lower Body'' by the game when summoned by it. The '''Splitter''' will also gain 800 health from this ability. The '''Splitter''' can be summoned by the [[Nuclear Monster]] with its ''Nuclear Summon'' ability. ==Appearance== The '''Splitter''' has black skin and giant teeth covering face. It wears torn brown clothes. Its torso is cut in half. Upon turning into the '''Lower Body''', its entire upper body disappears, leaving only its lower torso and legs. ==Strategy== *Multiple high DPS towers, like the [[Pursuit]], [[Accelerator]], [[Ranger]] and [[Engineer]] are recommended to take down the '''Splitter'''. *Support towers like the [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] can be useful at boosting the DPS of your towers. *As this enemy is quite fast, slowing towers like the [[Electroshocker]] and [[Freezer]] can be very useful against this. **Multiple such towers can also be used to drop its defense. *As it has the [[Burn Immunity]], it cannot be set on fire, also making it immune to having its defense reduced through burn. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1HexCorpseLowerBody.png|Green variant, current version, lower body variant (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseHexCorpse.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, Splitter variant (12 March 2025 – Present) CorpseHexCorpseLowerBody.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, Lower Body variant (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} HexCorpseIconIG.png|'''Splitter''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Splitter''' was originally from [[The Nightmare Realm]] and [[Containment]] of the [[Hexscape Event]] under the name ''"Hex Corpse"''. ==Update History== *'''19 February 2025''' -
